name: Candid
description: Bring the power of Candid's comprehensive nonprofit and funder data directly into Claude. Search millions of organizations, discover funding opportunities, and access expert knowledge and social sector news—all through natural conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Candid to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Candid to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.candid.org/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Candid MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Candid provides these MCP tools: knowledge_resources, identify_mentioned_organizations, search_organizations, taxonomy_terms, identify_locations, and current_date.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Candid?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Candid in nonprofit on the Manufact MCP catalog include Granted, hacesfalta, Benevity, Chariot, and Givebutter.
Candid requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Candid is developed by Candid. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
